* Decipher's errata changes only the lore: the Glossary strikes the word “hologram” (“Dejarik <s>hologram</s> of a Ng'ok war beast”). The game text is the printed card's. Bill ruled on 23 Nov 2026 that a lore-only errata is a real Decipher errata.
* Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered reprint [[Ng'ok (Revised)]] (September 1998). The card picture below it is that Revised card, whose game text is word for word this errata (read by eye beside the Glossary entry), recoloured to a black border by swccg.com in 2026: the drop shadow is cropped off, the white border is black and the corners are grey; nothing else is changed. File: [[:File:ANH-D-ngok-Decipher-Errata-1998-black.png]].
